verdict.rationale: Bench is a bookkeeping and tax service with a software layer, so asking for a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question for a SaaS product of this kind. The evidence pack documents no public API or OpenAPI spec, and probes of common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The customer-facing surface is reports, downloads and messaging, not a programmatic interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
